reviews.title: Absolutely Impressed!
reviews.comment: I upgraded my home gaming setup with this keyboard after considerable research, and it’s been a joy to use for both gaming and typing. Strengths: Premium typing experience: The pre-lubed cream linear switches and gasket mount deliver a “thocky” feel and satisfyingly smooth keystrokes. Typing and gaming are both quiet and comfortable, with five layers of foam dampening any hollow sounds. Customization: The included software lets me remap keys, create macros, and adjust more than 20 dynamic RGB lighting modes quickly. I loved being able to easily tweak the look and functionality. Build quality: PBT double-shot keycaps with an MDA profile feel sturdy and resist wear; they’re grippy and comfortable for long sessions. The detachable aluminum volume knob is a treat for instant control. Layout: The 98-key layout keeps the numpad and arrow keys but eliminates wasted space—a space-saving solution perfect for both gaming and work. Universal compatibility: Works perfectly with Windows and Mac out of the box, and includes both a 2-in-1 keycap/switch puller and extra switches for future customization. Bottom Line: This is an exceptional value for anyone who wants a customizable, quiet, and responsive keyboard for gaming, work, and creative projects. The smooth switches, full-featured software, and premium build make it a standout in its price range. Highly recommended for enthusiasts and everyday users alike.
reviews.author: walkebe

reviews.title: As per Description!!
reviews.comment: I’ve been using the RK Royal Kludge R98 Pro for a little over a week, and I’m honestly impressed with how much value this keyboard delivers. The moment you take it out of the box, it feels solid and well-built definitely not your typical budget keyboard. Typing Experience (5/5) The gasket mount design combined with the pre‑lubed linear switches makes typing incredibly smooth and quiet. It has that “creamy” feel everyone talks about. No pinging, no rattling just clean, soft keystrokes. The MDA profile PBT keycaps are thick, durable, and comfortable to type on. Design & Layout (5/5) I love the 96% layout. It saves desk space but still includes a full number pad, which I use constantly for work. The addition of the volume knob is a nice touch and works great for quick adjustments. RGB & Customization (4.5/5) The RGB is bright, vibrant, and offers a ton of effects. Customizing it is easy once you get familiar with the shortcuts. I only wish the software was a bit more intuitive, but it’s definitely not a deal‑breaker. Performance (5/5) For gaming, it’s responsive and stable with zero noticeable latency. Hot‑swappable sockets are a big win if you ever want to switch to different switches later. Overall If you’re looking for a keyboard that feels like a premium custom build for a fraction of the price, the RK R98 Pro is a fantastic choice. Great for both work and gaming, excellent build quality, and a super satisfying typing experience. Highly recommended!
reviews.author: Akshar

reviews.title: Solid keyboard for the price
reviews.comment: So I upgraded my desk setup to include this keyboard. I did minimal research but I knew I liked the color and the number pad. After having it for several months: 1. The keyboard is indeed "creamy" and smooth 2. The lighting is fun and the quality of the board is very nice. 3. It has a good weight and the volume knob is very helpful. 4. I am glad I didn't go smaller 5. The key swap capability is nice but I don't use it a whole lot. Overall a good keyboard to replace my Bluetooth work one. I definitely think this a worthy upgrade if you're in need of one.
reviews.author: Alexander Campos

reviews.title: THIS company has GREAT CUSTOMER SERVICE ! Great product
reviews.comment: I had an issue with the 3/4 size, and contacted the company. They were quick to respond, and offered a reasonable solution to my issue.  The keyboard feels tough. It is not cheaply made, at all.  It looks great, the lights can be changed to whatever floats your boat.  I use it daily and type pretty hard, and it definitely stands up to the daily abuse.  I have only found one thing that could be improved.  The little volume knob could be reinforced, a bit. But, it works fine!
